scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -s first -n ui,electron "bun --filter @agent-manager/ui dev --host 127.0.0.1" "bun scripts/wait-for-ui.ts && bun --filter @agent-manager/desktop dev"
scripts.smoke:electron: concurrently -k -s first -n ui,electron "bun --filter @agent-manager/ui dev --host 127.0.0.1" "bun scripts/wait-for-ui.ts && bun scripts/run-electron-smoke.ts"
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter @agent-manager/ui check && bun --filter @agent-manager/desktop typecheck && bun --filter @agent-manager/server typecheck
